units.source_text: 名人遗容的照片拍得怎么样呢？

en.t: How had the photograph of the Master's final likeness come out?
Before it was developed, I was very worried.

units.source_text: 我早就拜托在九段的野野宫照相馆冲洗了。

en.t: I had already arranged for it to be developed at the Nonomiya photo studio in Kudan.

units.source_text: 我将胶卷送到野野宫手里的时候，曾告诉他我拍的是名人的遗容，

en.t: When I handed the film to Nonomiya, I told him that what I had photographed was the Master's final likeness,

units.source_text: 希望他一定要精心冲洗。

en.t: and asked him to be sure to develop it with the greatest care.
